body:
Update coldstartEvidenceShape and coldstartIntegrityErrors in packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs so P0 coldstart validation fails when coldstart audited only a truncated prefix of the ticket.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Cache entries where textChars or current serialized ticket length exceeds cap (or 8000 when cap is absent) or where cap is invalid are rejected as incomplete evidence. Verify: node --test packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs
2. Prompt-only coldstart verdicts for tickets serializing over 64000 chars are rejected while untruncated evidence within cap is accepted. Verify: node --test packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs
title: runner: reject truncated coldstart evidence in P0 gate validator (#1197)
